message:
Support std::optional<T> in CheckTensors.

Composite graph builders with optional weight or cache tensors had to check each optional tensor separately after calling `CheckTensors` on the required inputs.

Add `GetTensorStatus` overloads for `TensorHandle` and `std::optional<T>` (treating `std::nullopt` as `absl::OkStatus()`) and update `CheckTensors` to accept `const Tensors&...` and forward through `GetTensorStatus`, allowing callers to validate required and optional tensors in a single call.
